defuss-shadcn / Website / Resume & Portfolio / portfolio-bento

Bento Portfolio

A whole portfolio on one screen - a bento of tiles in different colours, each one doing something: a portrait that opens the About dialog, availability with the quarter's slots and a Hire me form, the time in Tokyo, the work opening into case studies, three client quotes to flip through, links with an address to copy, writing in an accordion and what the designer is doing now. One of the Resume & Portfolio styles.

Open full screen

Aiko Tanaka, product designer

One grid of named areas (the page's own CSS): four columns wide, two at tablet width, one on a phone - a container query, so the card's device toolbar shows all three. Text Rotate in the intro, a corner-squircle portrait that opens an About dialog, Availability with a Progress of the quarter's slots and a Hire me dialog (Input, Select, Textarea), a pattern-grid tile with a pinging Indicator dot and the time in Tokyo (Intl.DateTimeFormat), a Portfolio Grid (bento) whose cases open the Media Gallery's viewer (commandfor + command="show-modal"), Skill Matrix (tags), three quotes picked by radios (:has()), labelled links with Copy (Clipboard API), an exclusive Accordion of notes and a Now list. data-df-stagger zooms the tiles in one by one.

×%

Built from Text Rotate, Availability, Indicator, Portfolio Grid (bento), Skill Matrix (tags), Progress, Accordion and two Dialogs with Input, Select and Textarea. The cases open in the Media Gallery's viewer. The tile grid is the page's own CSS - named areas that a container query rearranges. corner-squircle and pattern-grid are Shapes utilities; Motion's stagger zooms the tiles in.
